experiment_data.hypothesis: Budget-corrected L0 heuristic baseline (plan_015 修正版): 在 exact budget=0.25 下比较 3 种策略——(1) L0-random: L0@8-bit + k 个随机非 L0 heads@2-bit + rest@4-bit (5 seeds, mean±std), (2) MCKP optimal (已有结果), (3) Naive positional heuristic: L0@8-bit + 最深 k 个 heads@2-bit + rest@4-bit。k: Qwen=8, Llama/Mistral=16。直接量化 MCKP optimal selection 相对于随机/简单启发式的增益。
experiment_data.notes: Bug fixed: original script hardcoded MCKP PPL from different experiment (wrong values, e.g. Qwen MCKP=9.569 < baseline=9.81). Re-evaluated MCKP with same eval_ppl function. Correct MCKP PPL: Qwen=10.9131, Llama=8.4498, Mistral=7.3231. Main experiment crashed during Mistral seed=1; Mistral remaining conditions re-run separately. All results now consistent on identical eval data per model.
